prompts: Style-transfer edit of this existing adult female game NPC sprite. Goal: beautiful gentle appealing adult woman, matching hand-drawn low-resolution pixel-art NPCs rather than cute anime or realistic portrait. Prior attempt was too harsh and photorealistic: avoid angular hard jaw, gaunt cheeks, pronounced nasolabial folds, bags under eyes, wrinkles, masculine brow, deeply modeled realistic nose. Elegant soft oval face, natural moderately small eyes with delicate upper eyelid, subtle small nose indicated with just a few pixels, graceful relaxed brows, warm affectionate barely-there smile. Not childlike, no enlarged anime eyes, no big head, no blush stickers. Warm healthy peach/ochre skin, warm chestnut and cream colors, balanced palette instead of overall blue-gray coldness. Traditional drawn pixel-art flat shapes with minimal face shading, no painted skin modeling. Preserve source identity, age category, hairstyle and outfit, front-facing arms-down half-body posture, ORIGINAL small head relative to shoulders and SHORT natural neck. Do not increase head size, no high standing collar, no choker or necklace. Transparent background, single character. Crisp consistent logical pixel grid, approximately160x160 native game sprite, nearest-neighbor block presentation, limited palette up to16 colors and3–4 flat shades/material. No gradients, smoothing, antialiasing, glow, noise, glossy realism, 3D, thick black outline, white highlights, scenery, text or watermark. Change aesthetic carefully, don't replace character with generic beauty model. Specific identity: Oya, attractive adult saleswoman with auburn long softly wavy hair, subtle cream hair streak, round dark glasses with small naturally proportioned eyes visible, muted warm burgundy jacket and cream fold-down shirt collar. Friendly clever approachable expression. Keep her soft femininity and warm colors; glasses should not dominate face.
